title: Pixel Perfect Magic Mirror
description: Changes the items from the Magic Mirror mod by Quiltie to be pixel consistent with vanilla
body:
This resourcepack changes the sprites of the items added by the [**Magic Mirror**](https://modrinth.com/mod/qds-magic-mirror) mod by **Quiltie** to be 16x16 pixels, just like any vanilla item.

The textures are an edit of the original textures included with that mod.

Feel free to use in modpacks and the like.
